scope: Decision on whether a genuinely available lower bound before the first failure can help the same preinstalled RUL tools on three development replays. No new hardware claim. PRONOSTIA offset54, XJTU fifth-offset6, PHM08 all 72 services. Separate reference fleet, synchronized starts. Never use service failures for selection.
reference: Use at most one labeled forecast case per reference engine/bearing: freeze the first observed input at its actual initial measurement time. Each later reference observation supplies only the lower bound on residual time since that first forecast. Revealing an exact first-observation RUL is allowed only strictly after that reference's terminal event. No service observation or answer can enter maintenance. If measurement and service share a time, use strictly earlier reference events only.
policy: Candidate tool bank fixed: bearing phase, source median, CatBoost and cold official weight; engine source-restored official root, same-restored CatBoost and unrepaired root. Default phase or source-restored root as appropriate. For each tool relative to incumbent compute the minimum possible aggregate improvement in squared error over all independent reference units, one equal-weight first prediction per unit. For exact answers use the paired squared error difference. For right-censored targets, the infimum of (incumbent-y)^2-(candidate-y)^2 over y>=lower is negative infinity if candidate<incumbent; otherwise evaluate at lower. Switch only if the largest guaranteed mean improvement is strictly positive, tie by fixed bank order. A no-survival control applies the identical rule to completed units only. If evidence absent keep incumbent. No model refitting, labels or metadata in the single-row predictive models. Same constraints in both arms.
score: Report actual delivered RMSE overall and worst device, beats/losses relative to the starting version, strong fixed tools and exact-only switching, forecast counts before first terminal event, actual changed rows, exact labels and lower-bound observations. Require at least 1 percent reduction relative to every competitor and no more than 1 percent worse worst device. If no incremental differences or no gate, do not promote the rule. Stop developing it on these three replays.
